scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: for f in .env src/frontend/.env; do [ -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$f" ] && [ ! -e "$f" ] && cp "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$f" "$f"; done; true

scripts.name: Stack up (Docker)
scripts.command: export WORKTREE="$PWD" COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="$(git branch --show-current | tr "/A-Z" "-a-z")" BACKEND_PORT=7861 FRONTEND_PORT=3001; c() { docker compose -f "$HOME/.claude/skills/langflow/docker/compose.yml" "$@"; }; docker volume create langflow-agent-uv-cache >/dev/null; docker volume create langflow-agent-npm-cache >/dev/null; docker image inspect langflow-agent-base >/dev/null 2>&1 || c build; c up -d --wait --wait-timeout 900 && c logs -f

scripts.name: Stack down (Docker)
scripts.command: export WORKTREE="$PWD" COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="$(git branch --show-current | tr "/A-Z" "-a-z")" BACKEND_PORT=7861 FRONTEND_PORT=3001; c() { docker compose -f "$HOME/.claude/skills/langflow/docker/compose.yml" "$@"; }; c down -v
